purpose: Capture heartbeat supervision timeout, safe fault transition, and deterministic recovery after supervision resumes.
preconditions: Heartbeat timeout threshold is documented before the run.
Axis starts from Operation Enabled with no pending bus fault.

bench_extension.operator_action: Record the device heartbeat period, controller timeout setting, and exact method used to pause or remove heartbeat traffic.

operator_notes: This profile is useful for proving the difference between timing jitter and device-supervision loss.
On hardware, use the lowest-risk method available to stop heartbeat traffic.
